title: [review] spec/02-physical-link.md 4.5 still mandates FNV-1a32 for short-address DAD; contradicts CRC32-IEEE resolution everywhere else
description: P1, wave-7 review. spec/02-physical-link.md:435-500 (also :67) says 'Short-address DAD uses FNV-1a32 ... Implementations MUST match test/vectors/short_addr_dad.json' but the vector files (short_addr_dad.json:3, dad_hash_clarification.json:8-13), Python (short_addr.py), and Rust (short_addr.rs) now mandate CRC32-IEEE (init 0x4348454E, xorout 0xFFFFFFFF, poly 0xEDB88320); 04-network.md:250 already specifies crc32_ieee. A spec-literal implementation today fails the vectors and vice versa - recreates the duplicated-pseudocode ambiguity bo37 was filed to eliminate. Fix: spec-only edit - replace 4.5 FNV pseudocode + line 67 with the crc32_ieee form or cross-ref 04-network.md 12.3; keep FNV only for CCP channel/SF selection. Reviewer independently verified all corrected vector values (0x5dd5056e etc.) with a hand-rolled CRC oracle - the values are right, only the spec text is stale.
